name: logseq-plugin-geml-live-sync
description: GEML Live Sync for Logseq 2.0 DB graphs: your graph as a continuously synced, Git-friendly plain-text vault (powered by GEML). The plugin never touches your files — it signals the external geml-sync watcher when the graph changes and shows the last sync result; the sync and git live in the watcher.
